claim_text: I ordered a stroller and a car seat and my card was charged twice for the whole order. Only one box showed up with the stroller. Now the seller page says the car seat is out of stock. I want my money back for what I did not get and the extra charge.
label_notes: A second charge of 244.99 settled and the 244.99 car seat line never shipped.

claim_text: I can see two charges for the same knife set in my banking app and I need one of them returned. The seller says my order is fine but that does not explain why my available balance dropped twice this morning.
label_notes: One entry is a pending authorization and only one 86.00 charge settled.

claim_text: My rain jacket was supposed to arrive last week and the tracking has not moved beyond the carrier depot. I have checked the porch and asked my neighbors. I need the whole order refunded because nothing ever reached me.
label_notes: Carrier scans stop at the depot and no delivery scan exists for the sole item.

claim_text: I paid for the baby monitor after the page said it was available. The seller now says there are none left and cannot give me a date when one will be ready. I do not want to keep waiting for an item they cannot supply.
label_notes: The sole order line was oversold with no replenishment date inside the promised window.

claim_text: I paid extra for fast delivery of a charger and cable but the cable never came. The package only had the charger and the delivery fee on my receipt is higher than the price I chose. Please return the missing part and the extra fee.
label_notes: The cable worth 37.00 was absent and an extra 12.00 delivery fee settled.

claim_text: The tracking page insists my floor mirror was delivered but there is no mirror here. The seller also told me it was still waiting for stock when I asked yesterday. I cannot tell which story is right and I do not want to pay for something I never saw.
label_notes: Carrier records show delivery while warehouse records show no mirror was released.

claim_text: The wall lamp arrived without the matching shade and I was charged for both pieces. I got an email saying the shade is no longer available but my receipt still shows the full price. Please give me back the part I paid for and cannot get.
label_notes: Payment includes the 54.00 shade line and inventory shows that line was canceled.

claim_text: My card shows two completed payments for the headphones and dock. Amazon says the parcel was delivered but I received nothing and the seller says the dock never left its warehouse. I need someone to check what actually shipped before deciding what I owe.
label_notes: Two payments settled and delivery records conflict with the warehouse release record for the dock.

claim_text: I canceled the pet fountain while the cancellation button was still available. The order page confirms the cancellation but the full payment posted to my card two days later. I have not received a credit and want that charge returned.
label_notes: The cancellation preceded capture and the settled 72.00 charge has no offsetting credit.

claim_text: The replacement spatula cost me more than this order because I needed it for an event and I want 185 dollars back. The set arrived without its spatula. I noticed the seller also lists another color as out of stock but that is not what I ordered.
label_notes: The ordered spatula worth 24.00 is missing and the other color and replacement cost are unrelated.

claim_text: I got the notebooks from my order but the desk organizer keeps getting pushed back. The seller says it is unavailable again and cannot tell me when they will have one. I would rather keep the notebooks and get the organizer price back.
label_notes: The 46.00 organizer line remains unavailable while the delivered notebook lines can stand.

claim_text: My hiking pack never turned up and the tracking stopped before it reached my town. My card still has the full payment on it plus what looks like another charge for the same order. Please refund the pack since I have nothing to use.
label_notes: The pack was lost in transit and the apparent second charge is pending and never settled.

claim_text: The order says delivered so the seller keeps closing my messages. I have the towel set but not the bath mat and the stock email says the mat was never picked for packing. Please look at the actual boxes instead of treating one delivery scan as proof of everything.
label_notes: The delivery scan covers the towel box while pick records confirm the 38.00 mat never left stock.

claim_text: I ordered two packs of litter box liners and paid for both. The seller canceled one pack after saying the size was sold out but my card still shows the price for two. I received the other pack and only want the canceled one taken off my bill.
label_notes: Inventory canceled one 31.50 pack before fulfillment but payment captured both packs.

claim_text: my Card looks CHARGED twise and tracking first said delivered when nothing was here and the seller said the usb hub was OUT OF STOCK but the box came today with the hub inside and i still want all my money back
label_notes: Only one charge settled and the complete order was delivered after a corrected carrier scan.
